name: Waterton Lakes National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are allowed; some areas are closed to them.
summary: Leashed pets are allowed; some areas are closed to them.

excerpts.quote: At all times, pets must be kept on a leash or in suitable confinement.

dogRules.text: Some areas are closed to pets; check notices at trailheads.
No pets in campground kitchen shelters.
Mule deer with fawns can attack dogs, especially in spring; leave the area if you see one.
If pets must be left outside at camp, use a kennel with a secure top.
